svg.title: System architecture over the flight
svg.text: DRISHTI-PGK — system architecture over the flight
155 mm · de-spun ring and fixed canards · four fins, no actuator · the machine is both actuator and generator
Read the bands downwards as one chain: the flight, then what we sense, decide, drive and shed — and what the fuze will not do.
muzzle 546–943 m/s · body spin 1 108–1 913 rad/s (176–304 Hz) · ring rate ±31.42 rad/s · authority Δv 19.0 m/s
